# Rafiq v0.5.12: sees your screen and talks with you

## New
- **Ask about your screen.** A new shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+S, changeable in Settings → General) takes a picture of the screen under the mouse. Drag out the part you mean (Enter takes the whole screen) and the quick ask box opens with it attached, with one-press actions: explain it, what's wrong here, copy out the text, translate it. Needs a model that can see images.
- **Voice conversation.** The headphones button next to the mic starts a hands-free conversation: Rafiq listens until you stop talking, answers out loud, and listens again. Every reply also gets a "Listen" button. Windows' own voices are used by default (free, nothing leaves your computer); when Windows has no voice for the language — common for Arabic — Rafiq uses the local voice from Video settings or an OpenAI voice. Settings → General → Voice picks who reads.
- **Tasks that start themselves.** Schedules can now start on an event, not only a time: a new file in a folder (with optional patterns like `*.pdf`), copied text (any, English/Latin, Arabic, or a link), or a program opening. Files already there, text already copied and programs already open never start anything; downloads are waited for until they finish. Each trigger waits between runs and starts at most 30 tasks an hour. A trigger task's result shows in the Windows notification.
- **Find your files by what's in them.** Ask "where's the March invoice?" and Rafiq finds it from what's written inside. It keeps an index of Documents, Desktop and Downloads (or the folders you choose) on your computer only, reading text, Markdown, code, CSV, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and PDF; other files are found by name. The model searches with every way the thing might be written, in Arabic and English. Settings → General → Search your files.
- **Up to 4 chats side by side** on the chat page.
- **Richer 3D in Motion.** Ready-made trees, bushes, rocks, mountains, clouds, houses, buildings (8 forms, 8 tops, 5 façades), whole cities, cars, people, street lamps, roads, fences, benches and water that reflects; boxes are rounded by default; and a full 3D guide. The model can look up a real photo (`motion_reference`) and copy a place tower by tower.

## Fixed
- Switching the theme could leave the globe blank until Rafiq was restarted.

## Updating
Rafiq offers the update by itself. Or download `Rafiq_0.5.12_x64-setup.exe` below and check it:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.12_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```
